description: Rappi restaurant menu and prices (Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Uruguay, Ecuador, Costa Rica): for a Rappi store ID returns store name, brand, address, open status, ETA, delivery fee, rating and reviews, cuisine tags, weekly schedule, active offers, and the menu by section with each product's price, original price, discount %, availability and description.
